annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously specifies that when a decompressed field section contains multiple cookie field lines, they must be concatenated using the delimiter 0x3b, 0x20 before being passed into any context other than HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 (e.g., HTTP/1.1 or a generic HTTP server). The wording leaves no room for multiple reasonable interpretations or missing constraints.
